items.why: The watchlist's biggest decliner, caught in a chip-stock selloff. Business Insider reports chaos in Korea's market is sending shockwaves through US chip stocks, and Reuters notes the Nasdaq ended down as chipmakers fell.

Wall Street is hiking Meta's 2027 AI capex forecasts, with Guggenheim lifting its estimate to $225B, reviving fears of a perpetual over-investment cycle around Muse and its new Wonder models, per Barron's.
Sliding with chipmakers broadly. Reuters reports the Nasdaq ended down as chipmakers fell, while Korea market turmoil is rippling into US chip stocks, per Business Insider.

Barron's notes Tesla slipped Wednesday as investors digest self-driving news, including the exit of Uber's autonomous mobility chief; separately, BNP Paribas flagged cash-burn worries after Tesla guided 2026 capex above $25B.

market_note: Yields rising as futures point lower into the afternoon; bank earnings continue.
summary: A hot inflation report is hitting stocks, putting another Fed rate hike back on the table. S&P futures are down about 1%, the VIX is up over 4%, and chip stocks are leading the selloff.
